ignoreValues.reason: CSS-triangle idiom (border-top + transparent border-left) drawing the stop-count corner wedge and legend wedge; documented as the design system's signature geometry in DESIGN.md Shapes. Not a decorative side border.
Two Family Rule (DESIGN.md Typography): Geist + Geist Mono, self-hosted, no third-party font request. Chosen as a neutral invisible workhorse for a quiet instrument, not a display voice.
The 45-degree hatch on td.nodata and its legend swatch is the load-bearing 'no cached data' cell encoding, per DESIGN.md named rules. Not surface decoration.

11px is the DESIGN.md 11px Floor Rule: labels, tags, hints, and card/row metadata (country, dates, price ceiling) run at 11px as a deliberate density choice and clear AA. Body prose and inputs are 14px+ (16px on touch).
